notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center reports the following changes:
[list]
 [*]Increased stability of the coop mode
 [*]Network code corrected
 [*]First Aid Kit now includes a secret ingredient that heals cuts
 [*]Minor fixes and improvements
[/list]
If any failure occurs during the operation "Cooperative game", please contact us directly at ROC. Coordinates of the Center – [b]support@distrust.info[/b]

Over!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28830244/ad389da9564d702eed43515c16a39edd4625eaa8.png[/img]

notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center informs:
[list]
[*]Now you and your partners can get achievements in COOP mode
[*]Polars from Turkey will find Turkish localization at the base
[*]Crucial number of bugs was fixed by a squad of licensed professionals
[/list]
Over and out

notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
[b]Rescue Operation Center informs![/b]
The latest package delivered to the base contains:
[list]
[*]The fixed bug that led to an error during a co-op session if a player’s nickname had specific symbols;
[*]A zillion of small, but necessary bugfixes;
[*]The Italian localization provided by Marcello Brancaccio!
[/list]
Over and out.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28830244/860ee30e9d9672cef0aa872b013c9fcde2bae8dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Distrust Update
notes.notes:
Rescue Operation Center informs:
[list]
[*]Multiple incoming messages state that the anomalies have changes their outer appearance. Be careful!
[*]An additional language package featuring Korean language is delivered to the base! NOTE that this localization was prepared by our polar fan [b]Cris Lee[/b].
[*]Closed CO-OP Test will begin in the nearest days. The registration is still open at https://alawar.typeform.com/to/ZutbFX [i](NB: you must have Distrust in your Steam library to participate).[/i]
[/list]
Over and out.


[img]https://alawar.sharepoint.com/AlawarPremium/presskit/_layouts/15/guestaccess.aspx?docid=0965b9d38d27449269612fa6235af073b&authkey=AbS86T4xcgrTPmbzjBPQR14[/img]
